text:
rene: Quick sync: carving out the long-term routing/tenant isolation roadmap for next two quarters. Want to lock down launch gates + migration waves for paid tenancy.

asha: High level asks from sales: (1) firm per-tenant isolation option, (2) regional residency guarantee, (3) a deterministic fallback if dedicated capacity is exhausted.

carlos: For determinism we should codify a fallback chain: pinned -> preferred-region -> model-degrade -> spill-to-public. Make it auditable.

jun: +1. Also need to surface the chain in telemetry so we can see how often tenants hit degrade step. Tracking event: routing.fallback.{step}.

kate: Risk note: cross-region cache invalidation during failover caused a customer incident last month. If we allow cross-region failover we MUST have warm caches or cheap reconvergence. Otherwise SLA claims break.

deploy-bot: deploy:policy-dsl-v0.3 promoted to staging by jun at 2025-11-03T09:12:22Z

rene: Proposal: phased onramp waves -> wave 0 (internal + beta tenants), wave 1 (sales-driven small customers), wave 2 (reserved capacity customers), wave 3 (enterprise). Each wave has mandatory checklist.

asha: Checklist items (draft):
 - policy DSL approved by product/legal
 - telemetry events implemented (routing decisions + fallback reasons)
 - canary plan with automatic rollback
 - customer-specific residency config tested
 - pricing appendix updated

carlos: Suggest adding an "eviction policy" behavior: if host runs out of memory, we try model-swap, then soft-queue requests for 30s, then fail. Soft-queue better than instant fail.

jun: For model-swap we need quality knobs and a way to surface "quality degraded" warnings to customers. Maybe a header: X-Redwood-Quality: degraded; flag for SDKs.

kate: Legal/security: any single-region tenancy must include KMS binding + audit retention. Marie from security needs final signoff.

marie: I'll review. We also need threat model notes for per-tenant isolation (side-channel, noisy-neighbor). Add a short mitigation list.

rene: Pricing implications: reserving cross-region replication or pinning reduces efficiency. Product needs scenarios: (A) pin in-region (higher cost), (B) replicate KV (medium cost), (C) best-effort cold-start (lower cost + availability risk).

asha: Can we include a small decision matrix in the public-facing doc? Sales wants a short one-pager to show customers tradeoffs.

carlos: Draft DSL example (YAML style) to capture the main knobs:

```yaml
tenant_policy:
  tenant_id: "acme-123"
  isolation: "single-region" # single-region | shared-isolated | best-effort
  region: "eu-central-1"
  fallback:
    - type: "model_degrade"
      target: "quantized-medium"
    - type: "spill"
      target: "public-default"
  canary: {percent: 10, duration_minutes: 30}
  eviction_behavior: "model_swap_then_soft_queue"
```

jun: Nice. Keep it small. We must map these fields to runtime knobs (replication=true, pin=true, admission_control=soft-queue).

kate: Timeline ask: customers want a plan within 2 weeks. Can we commit to a public pilot by then?

rene: Realistic: DSL + checklist + pricing one-pager in 10 business days; pilot (wave 1) setup depends on infra readiness but aim for pilot signups in 4 weeks.

marie: Security review target: end of next week if DSL is small and docs include mitigation notes.

asha: Action items: carlos -> PR with DSL example + mapping to runtime (T+4 days); jun -> telemetry events + schema (T+3 days); kate -> legal/security kickoff with Marie (today); rene -> pricing scenarios and wave definitions (T+5 days).

carlos: One operational question: do we allow per-route hard pinning without a contract? My vote: disallow unless entitlement flag present.

jun: agree. enforce via entitlement service and surface in the UI as "pinned route (billed)".

rene: final note: keep the routing policy expressible but intentionally limited. We want surface area small for legal and testability.

asha: I'll consolidate and put a one-pager in Confluence and ping #sales.

deploy-bot: reminder: policy-dsl-v0.4 scheduled for staging promotion on 2025-11-10

rene: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll merge the checklist into the roadmap doc by EOD. :white_check_mark:
